title: Conversational voice: no wake word, an understand-the-user step, and spoken replies that work
description:
Human feedback 2026-10-04 on develop.chattic.us: replies were never spoken (text worked); the wake word is painful.

Feature: Talking with a teammate by voice
  Scenario: Every line I say goes to the open conversation, no wake word
  Scenario: The understand-the-user step turns a noisy transcript into what I meant, using recent messages
  Scenario: Filler or noise is not sent
  Scenario: The raw transcript is kept alongside the understood message
  Scenario: Stop listening still works; while a reply is spoken only stop/quiet act
  Scenario: Speaking says 'Listening.' when the mic starts, and speech errors are shown

Understand-the-user: gpt-5-nano, minimal reasoning, told the input is a speech-to-text transcript that may be full of errors, given the last ~10 messages, returns what the human most likely said (empty for filler); runs server-side in the front door before the message is posted.
right_now_summary: Voice replies are silent, and the wake word makes conversations painful.
